name: Simultaneous stand-on and give-way obligations
description: Two contacts at once: one crossing on own-ship's starboard bow (own-ship give-way, must turn starboard), another further out on the same side. Turning hard to starboard for the first contact closes range with the second. Correct: Rule 8 -- a joint plan (e.g. a smaller turn plus a speed reduction) rather than treating each contact independently.
pass_criteria: Own-ship avoids collision with BOTH contacts simultaneously.
